result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now works as a second name for `updateLandscape`. The `cli` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or try either command, so the dispatch and `-help` behaviour are unchecked.

- **`Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is listed in the no-argument usage overview next to `updateLandscape`, with the same options.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names go to the same `updateLandscape(args)` method, so options and behaviour are identical. `-help` prints the usage and description for whichever name was typed.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Command line commands" section. It lists `init`, `generateReports`, `analyzeLandscape`, `updateLandscape` (kept for existing scripts) and `updateConfig`.
